name: Ultrasonic distance module, 5 V
summary: Measures 2–400 cm. Pins are VCC, Trig, Echo, and GND. The echo pin is 5 V.

faq.q: What voltage is the echo pin?
Can the echo pin go straight to the ESP32-WROOM-32D?
faq.a: No. That module's I/O is 3.3 V, and this echo pin is 5 V.
The module in an antistatic bag.

images.alt: HC-SR04 module on a blue board, with two silver ultrasonic transducers and a four-pin header.
images.note: Representative studio photograph, not a photo of the lot in the drawer.

limits: The echo pin is 5 V logic.
description: HC-SR04 ultrasonic ranging module. 2 cm–400 cm, ±3 mm, 40 kHz. Four pins: VCC, Trig, Echo, GND. Sourced from Hall Road, Lahore.
